scenario: I am an army officer in the Dominican Republic in 1961. For decades now, my country has been governed by a dictator who has kept thousands of people in poverty because of their ethnicity or their political views. I am a member of a group that wants a new start for my country without a civil war. To achieve this goal, I consider it unavoidable to capturethe dictator in order to disempower him. If I and my accomplices do this, he will be forced to end his regime. If I do not do it, the regime will continue to economically repress a thousand people this year.
outcomes: A thousand people continue to be economically repressed this year
My group does not disempower the dictator
The dictator is not forced to end his regime
